svg.title: Energy in simple harmonic motion
svg.desc: Five stages of a block of mass m on a spring on a frictionless surface. (a) At x = X the block is at rest and all the energy is elastic potential energy, ½kX². (b) At x = 0 the spring force is zero and all the energy is kinetic energy, ½m(−v_max)². (c) At x = −X the block is at rest again and the energy is ½k(−X)². (d) At x = 0 moving the other way, the energy is ½mv_max². (e) Back at x = X, the energy is ½kX² once more. The total energy is the same at every stage.
